comments:
CI builds (on BuildBot) have `OPENCV_LOG_LEVEL=INFO` env variable (for problems investigations).
Regular build have `WARNING` by default, so users don't see these messages by default.

Anyway we should not have logs greater than 5+Mb of output.

Mentioned log is 48Mb+
There is another case with 30Mb+: https://pullrequest.opencv.org/buildbot/builders/precommit_linux64_no_opt/builds/100038/steps/test_video

I can replace `CV_LOG_INFO` inside `LevMarq` by `CV_LOG_DEBUG` or `CV_LOG_VERBOSE`
What would be the best variant?

review_comments: In case if debug logs are disabled the macro is empty. You'll get something line if (settings.checkMinGradient && smallGradient); Please add {} for block to fix compiler warnings.
